10k.note: Avanos operates two reportable segments: Specialty Nutrition Systems (SNS) and Pain Management and Recovery (PM&R). Both are medical device portfolios. No drug or biologic pipeline disclosed.

website.note: 404 on both common pipeline URLs; medtech device companies typically do not publish a drug-style pipeline page.

ctgov.note: Nine sponsor matches returned, none classified as P1/P2/P3 interventional drug trials. Consistent with device post-market / observational studies.

commercial_product.summary: Avanos Medical is a medical device company focused on improving patient outcomes and reducing the cost of care. Two reportable segments.

segments.name: Specialty Nutrition Systems (SNS)
products: NeoMed neonatal and pediatric feeding solutions

segments.name: Pain Management and Recovery (PM&R)
products: Game Ready cold and compression therapy systems

recent_divestitures: HA (hyaluronic acid) product line sold to CMM (July 31, 2025)

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Pure medical device company. Portfolio comprises non-opioid pain management and enteral feeding devices regulated via FDA 510(k)/PMA pathways, not P1/P2/P3 drug trials. No proprietary drug or biologic pipeline disclosed in 10-K and no qualifying P1/P2/P3 sponsor-led trials on ClinicalTrials.gov.
